name: Spacebot
description: Runs a multi-user agent harness for Discord, Slack, Telegram, and Twitch with shared graph memory, tasks, cron jobs, and coding workers, for teams and communities.

skills.name: Typed Graph Memory
skills.description: Stores typed memories with importance scores and graph edges and recalls them with hybrid vector and full-text search.

skills.name: Task Execution
skills.description: Runs tasks with execution plans, dependency gating, and spec-driven markdown descriptions through worker agents.

skills.name: Conversational Cron Jobs
skills.description: Turns natural-language requests into scheduled jobs that deliver results to a chosen channel.

skills.name: Messaging Adapters
skills.description: Connects one agent to Discord, Slack, Telegram, Twitch, Signal, Mattermost, email, webchat, and webhooks.

skills.name: Learned Skills
skills.description: Distills successful multi-step work into reusable skills and installs skills from the skills.sh registry.
